text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios also ended up participating in the joint interview with the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Trai-pi! My racing outfit!
Since I'm doing an interview, should I glam it up even more?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Silver streamer tape and star-shaped sunglasses, and stick on some sequins too~~!!
choice_data_list: Just do what you always do!

text_block_list.text: Honestly, it's about to begin any moment. Helios-san, are you prepared?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
McQueeeen!!
Nice encounter! I'm so stoked you're here☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, how hype is the venue getting?
What kinda BPM are we talkin' right now~~?!
choice_data_list: What do you mean, how warm I got...

text_block_list.text:
The press straightened up as they took their seats.
With guests from the URA also assembled...
a solemn atmosphere enveloped the venue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "It may be conducted as an interview... but this is effectively a declaration of resolve before the dignitaries. I cannot let my guard down."
choice_data_list: It's a solemn ceremony, are you going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Solemn? Like, super stiff?
No prob, no prob! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm super good at riding the momentum!
I'll nail this in style!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the Mejiro pride in my heart,
I swear to bring glory to my clan.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your answer.
Your noble aspirations truly resonated with me. Moving on—

Next is finally Daitaku Helios's turn.
Tightened lips. A straightened spine.
It seems she's reading the room.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pop-pop-pop-POOOOOW!!
Everyday Sunshine a.k.a.
Daitaku Helios in the houuuse★☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally lit!
(Silence...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy! What's up?
Quit being so solemn and smile more☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... Just a second!
Do it over properly...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
W-What do you mean why... Just look around you!
This isn't a place where you can just act like your usual—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Well, but this is just who I am, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey hey! My racing outfit is insanely cute, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"A flashy blue party-animal outfit!
There's no way this won't get my hype levels through the roof!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And plus! Everyone will recognize
that it's me right away, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
An' so! An' so!
When you spot me, I want you to go all-out
with the Helios call☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Shouting, jumping, and getting hyped together!
Isn't that just super fun?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If you wear this, it's fever time anytime, anywhere!
Everyone around you is a friend!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"You all know what I mean, right!?
That feeling of, like, 'THIS is who I am!'"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So yeah! Consider this my policy statement☆ Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere, no matter the circumstances.
I'll stay true to who I am and enjoy every moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That vow is so very typical of Helios-san.
choice_data_list: To stick to that even here...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
――Still... that's what a declaration is all about, right?
――Yeah! I want to stay true to myself, too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right on~~?! Hype levels through the roof! Don't you dare forget your promise to meee☆★!!

text_block_list.name: Guest of Honor
text_block_list.text:
My, what an interesting Umamusume.
In just an instant, she brings a positive influence to everyone around her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Let's give a round of applause for Daitaku Helios!
We'll always be cheering on that hype energy of yours!

Applause filled the venue.
Though it was an outlandish declaration of resolve, her feelings
had been embraced by the people gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-piii~~!!
Did you see that!? Wasn't that totally hype!?
choice_data_list: You were amazing out there, weren't you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trai-piii~~!!
Did you see that!? Wasn't that totally hype!?
choice_data_list: You were amazing out there, weren't you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! I told ya to leave it to me, didn't I?!
I'm a crazy genius who hypes things up anywhere I go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes, I'll keep Trainie smiling the whole time too☆
Getting hyped together! That's a promise too!

The unflappable laugher, Daitaku Helios.
Her overwhelming positivity was something
I found truly dependable in that moment.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My bad!
All's well that ends well though, yay☆
choice_data_list: Well, just for this time, yeah?
Well, just for this time, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
Besides, I don't need your worry or your lectures!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean~... I'm Chan-Heli, aren't I?
I'll blast away any bad vibes or sad tears and hype everyone up!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Stick with me and it's a guaranteed happy ever after!
Right?
